issues.title: Kenya receives eight modernized MD-500 helicopters in trilateral security handover
issues.title_en: Kenya receives eight modernized MD-500 helicopters in trilateral security handover
issues.summary: The handover is the result of a trilateral arrangement involving Kenya, South Korea, and the United States. The aircraft were donated surplus by South Korea, while the United States funded and supported their refurbishment, digital system upgrades, and crew training.

issues.title_en: Jordan arrests three men suspected of deadly church attack after shootout
issues.summary: No group has yet said it was behind Friday's shooting attack in the village of Hmoud, which left nine Christians dead.
